ourStory.headline: SMARTGRID SURVEYING & ENGINEERING
ourStory.description: At Smartgrid Surveying, established 2020. We're redefining the future of land and aerial surveys across Africa and beyond. With cutting-edge technology and an unwavering commitment to precision, we offer a full suite of professional surveying services that support infrastructure development, land administration, environmental monitoring, and planning projects of all scales.

aerialSurveying.headline: AERIAL SURVEYING
aerialSurveying.description: Drones have transformed the surveying industry—and we're leading the way. Smartgrid Surveying leverages aerial drones for mapping, 3D modeling, volumetrics, environmental assessments, and monitoring large or inaccessible areas. Beyond technical mapping, we offer professional drone photography for real estate, construction marketing, tourism, and events. Using drones equipped with RTK GPS and high-resolution sensors, we capture precise geospatial data that empowers engineers, developers, governments, and NGOs to make smarter decisions, faster.

landSurveying.headline: SMARTGRID LAND SURVEYING
landSurveying.description: At Smartgrid Surveying, we're redefining the future of land and aerial surveys across Africa and beyond. With cutting-edge technology and an unwavering commitment to precision, we offer a full suite of professional surveying services that support infrastructure development, land administration, environmental monitoring, and planning projects of all scales. Smartgrid Surveying provides comprehensive land surveying solutions tailored to developers, governments, contractors, and private clients. Whether it's for title deeds, boundary demarcation, construction layouts, or cadastral mapping, we bring experience and excellence to every site.

impactAcrossAfrica.headline: Impact Across Africa
impactAcrossAfrica.description: From Kenya's Rift Valley to forests in the Congo Basin, and urban expansion in Accra, Ghana, Smartgrid Surveying has completed projects spanning thousands of hectares, transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support development, climate resilience, and sustainable land use.
